newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent touches session high as NYMEX rallies.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent touches session high as NYMEX rallies.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures extended afternoon gains on Tuesday, pushed higher by fund buying on NYMEX crude and products markets, dealers said.
"There's been some good interest from Wall Street in WTI (NYMEX crude) in the last half an hour. Products are strong too," said a broker.
May Brent, trailing in the wake of a 38-cent gain on prompt NYMEX crude, added 25 cents to $19.75 a barrel by 1702 GMT, just five cents off the session high posted moments earlier.
Dealers said a break through technical resistance on April NYMEX at $21.25 a barrel fuelled additional buying interest.
IPE April gas oil also gained ground, helped by strength on U.S. heating oil markets. By 1705 GMT, April gas oil had added 75 cents to $171.50 a tonne, just 50 cents off the intraday high.

Some dealers said news of an explosion which shut the 200,000 barrels per day (bpd) Cano Limon pipeline in Colombia was helping push prices higher, but others said the report of the terrorist attack, the 13th on the pipeline this year, had no impact.
"That pipeline is always going down. This rally is all about U.S. technicals," said a broker.
The next significant fundamental news was likely to be weekly U.S. stocks data to be released after the close of trading on Tuesday.
